answer: The grove schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the jetty checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. A hostile operator wanting 95 effective identities must lock that capital for 76 epochs and keep it locked through every orchard audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 76 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
